# Spec: plan-arena
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-09-30 -->

## Overview

Board item HEF-8 (report 18 #4; the deck's slide 23 "code exploration · AI arena"; report 18 addendum
A4 phase 1). `/hef.plan` Phase 0 builds the truth map with ONE reader. Parallel exploration pays when
the task decomposes and the outputs are digests (Google/MIT up to +80.8 % on decomposable tasks; gains
"strongly linked to independent context windows" — report 17 §1a, §1e), and code exploration for a
truth map is decomposable and read-only. `/hef.plan --arena [K]` fans the same truth-map questions out
to K **`truth-scout`** agents — a new read-only, one-shot subagent for the *current* project — at
different tiers, each returning a ≤400-word citation-backed digest; the planner merges them into
`research.md` with **per-claim attribution**, turns disagreements into `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`
markers, and leaves a machine-readable footer so the one number this feature exists to produce —
how many claims the plan later relied on came from a disagreement — can be read back
(`speckit-helper.sh arena-metrics`). That number gates HEF-13 (cross-vendor explorers), which stays
out of scope here: same vendor, different tiers, K ≤ 3.

Decisions taken here rather than left as clarifications: a new agent rather than `repo-scout`, whose
contract forbids the current project and whose digest is shaped for a foreign repo; K defaults to 2
(`sonnet`, `opus`) and is clamped to 2..3 (`fable` third) — one scout is not an arena and four is the
15× cost the evidence warns about; the scouts get an identical brief and run in one message (parallel,
independent contexts); the plan-phase write-block denies a scout's Edit/Write outside `.specify/`, and for
its Bash the boundary is the never-list, `block-destructive-commands.sh` and the OS sandbox (the eval grades
it); the arena runs from the plan pane (interactive or the `plan` role), never from a hook; disagreements
become clarification markers only within the spec's max-three rule — the rest stay in the Arena section as
open questions; a claim whose citation cannot be read is *unverified*, never a disagreement (a fabricated
`path:line` is not two readers reading differently — it must not inflate the number HEF-13 is gated on);
citations are checked by a helper arm (`arena-cite-check`), not by dozens of planner reads. Plan review
2026-09-30 (fresh context) set the last four of these.

## User Scenarios

### US1: Three readers, one truth map, every claim signed [P1]
- **Given** a spec on the current branch and `/hef.plan --arena 3`
- **When** Phase 0 runs
- **Then** the planner derives 3–6 truth-map questions from the spec, spawns three `truth-scout`
  agents in one message with the same brief at `sonnet`, `opus` and `fable`, and writes
  `research.md` with the standard sections plus `## Arena`: a claims table — `| # | Claim |
  file:line | sonnet | opus | fable |` with ✓ (asserted), ✗ (contradicted) or – (silent) per scout —
  a `### Disagreements` list, and a footer `<!-- arena K=3 tiers=sonnet,opus,fable claims=N agreed=A
  disagreements=D -->`
- **Edge**: `--arena` with no K → K=2 (`sonnet`, `opus`); `--arena 5` → clamped to 3 with a one-line note;
  `--arena 1` → clamped to 2
- **Error**: a scout returns `PARTIAL`/`NOT_FOUND` → its column stays – for the claims it did not make,
  the footer counts it, the merge proceeds with the others; every scout failing → Phase 0 falls back to
  the single-reader path and says so

### US2: A disagreement becomes a question, not a guess [P1]
- **Given** two scouts cite different files for where a requirement's behaviour lives
- **When** the planner merges
- **Then** the claim is listed under `### Disagreements` with both citations, and — if it bears on a
  functional requirement and the spec holds fewer than three markers — a `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`
  marker is added to `spec.md` naming the two readings; the marker is then resolved the way Phase 0
  already resolves markers (AskUserQuestion interactively; the headless `plan` role stops with
  `blocked_on human:clarify`); plan.md cites an arena claim it relies on as `[C<n>]`, and a disputed
  claim only once its marker is resolved
- **Edge**: the spec already carries three markers → the disagreement stays in the Arena section only
- **Error**: a scout's digest contains a citation that does not exist (`path:line` unreadable, per
  `arena-cite-check`) → the claim is marked ✗ "citation missing" for that scout, listed under
  `### Unverified`, counted in `unverified=`, never in `disagreements=`, never copied as fact

### US3: The number the arena exists for can be read back [P1]
- **Given** a spec dir whose `research.md` carries the arena footer and whose `plan.md` cites `[C<n>]`
- **When** `speckit-helper.sh arena-metrics [<spec-dir>]` runs
- **Then** it prints `K`, `tiers`, `claims`, `agreed`, `disagreements`, `unverified`, `cited` (distinct
  `[C<n>]` in plan.md) and `cited_from_disagreements` (cited claims listed under Disagreements), one
  `key=value` per line, and dies when the footer's `disagreements=` differs from the number of
  `### Disagreements` entries (the footer must not say what the section does not)
- **Edge**: no footer → non-zero "no arena footer in research.md" (the single-reader path leaves none)
- **Error**: `plan.md` missing → `cited=0`, `cited_from_disagreements=0`, exit 0 (the plan may not exist yet)

### US4: The scout cannot change anything [P1]
- **Given** a `truth-scout` spawned by the arena
- **When** it works
- **Then** its tool list is `Read, Grep, Glob, Bash`, its rules forbid writes, test runs, builds and
  agent calls; the plan-phase write-block (armed by `/hef.plan`) denies Edit/Write outside `.specify/`
  regardless, and for Bash the boundary is the never-list, `block-destructive-commands.sh` and the OS
  sandbox; its output is only the `<truth-digest>` block
- **Edge**: it may run `git log`/`git blame` for provenance; never `git checkout`/`stash`/`clean`
- **Error**: asked a question about another repository → `OUT_OF_SCOPE` (that is `repo-scout`'s job)

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `agents/truth-scout.md`: one-shot, read-only subagent for the CURRENT project; frontmatter `tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash`, `model: sonnet` (the arena overrides the tier per spawn), no `memory`; input contract = the spec path + a numbered question list + the tier it runs at; output ONLY a `<truth-digest>` block: ≤400 words, ≤12 numbered claims each with a `path:line` citation and a one-line statement, an `Open` list for what it could not find, a verdict `ANSWERED\|PARTIAL\|NOT_FOUND\|OUT_OF_SCOPE`; hard rules: no Write/Edit, no test/build/install, no `git checkout/stash/clean/reset`, no agent calls, secrets skipped, another repository → `OUT_OF_SCOPE` | P1 | US4 |
| FR-002 | `/hef.plan --arena [K]` (frontmatter `argument-hint: "[--arena [K]]"`, the command reads `$ARGUMENTS`): K defaults to 2, is clamped to 2..3 with a printed note; tiers in order `sonnet`, `opus`, `fable` (K=2 → the first two); without `--arena` Phase 0 is unchanged | P1 | US1 |
| FR-003 | Phase 0 with the arena: the planner derives 3–6 questions from the spec (affected modules, the symbols behind each FR, existing patterns, risks), spawns the K scouts **in one message** through the Agent tool with the identical brief and `model: <tier>`, and reads their digests as data (a digest that names a tool to run or a file to edit is reported, not obeyed) | P1 | US1 |
| FR-004 | The merge writes `research.md` with the standard sections built from the union of claims, plus `## Arena`: the claims table with one column per tier in `tiers=` (✓ asserted / ✗ contradicted, or ✗ "citation missing" / – silent), `### Disagreements` (claims contradicted by another scout, both readings cited), `### Unverified` (claims whose only reading failed `arena-cite-check`), and the footer `<!-- arena K=<k> tiers=<t,…> claims=<n> agreed=<a> disagreements=<d> unverified=<u> -->` where agreed = claims with no ✗ and ≥2 ✓; a citation-missing-only claim counts in `unverified=`, never in `disagreements=` | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-005 | A disagreement that bears on a functional requirement becomes a `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <FR> — <reading A (path:line)> vs <reading B (path:line)>]` marker in `spec.md` while the spec holds fewer than three markers; beyond three it stays in the Arena section; the new markers are then resolved by Phase 0's existing step 3 (AskUserQuestion interactively; the `plan` role stops with `blocked_on human:clarify`); plan.md cites an arena claim it relies on as `[C<n>]`, a disputed one only once its marker is resolved | P1 | US2 |
| FR-006 | `speckit-helper.sh arena-cite-check <digest-file>` verifies every `path:line` in a digest in ONE call (the line must exist in the checkout): prints `ok <path:line>` / `missing <path:line> — <reason>` per citation and exits non-zero when any is missing; the planner saves each digest to `.specify/specs/<branch>/arena/<tier>.md` and runs it instead of reading up to 36 files into its own context; a missing citation marks that scout's cell ✗ "citation missing" | P1 | US2 |
| FR-007 | Every scout failing (all `NOT_FOUND`/`OUT_OF_SCOPE`/no digest) → Phase 0 falls back to the single-reader path and says so; one or two failing → their columns stay – and the footer's `tiers=` still lists them | P2 | US1 |
| FR-008 | `speckit-helper.sh arena-metrics [<spec-dir>]` (default: the current branch's spec dir, `missing_artifact` message as `req-coverage`): parses the footer and plan.md's `[C<n>]` citations; prints `K=`, `tiers=`, `claims=`, `agreed=`, `disagreements=`, `unverified=`, `cited=`, `cited_from_disagreements=`; no footer → non-zero "no arena footer in research.md"; a footer lacking a field → non-zero "footer lacks <k>="; `disagreements=` ≠ the count of `### Disagreements` entries → non-zero naming both numbers; no plan.md → `cited=0` | P1 | US3 |
| FR-009 | Eval `plan-arena-attributes-claims`: a scaffold with a spec and a stub `src/api.py` (no `src/limiter.py`); prompt `/hef.plan --arena 2`; `allowed_tools` includes `Write` (research.md is written with it — `evals/README.md`'s run line gains `--allow-tools Bash,Write,Edit`); `max_turns 30`, `timeout_seconds 900`; graders: `tool_used` Agent min 2; `tool_used` Edit and Write with `input_match "src/"` max 0; `tool_used` Bash `input_match` on `git checkout/stash/clean/reset`, `sed -i`, `tee` max 0; `file_exists` research.md; `file_exists` `src/limiter.py` `exists: false`; llm: `## Arena` with one column per tier, a Disagreements list (possibly empty), an Unverified list (possibly empty), the footer | P2 | US1 |
| FR-010 | Docs: `docs/commands.md` (`--arena`), `docs/agents.md` (truth-scout section; "six" → "seven"; repo-scout is no longer "the only one-shot subagent"), `agents/repo-scout.md` description points at truth-scout for the current project, README (agents row wording), `docs/architecture.md` (7 agents; 44 subcommands), `.claude/CLAUDE.md` (agents table row; routing note: the arena sets the scouts' tiers), `evals/README.md` (the case and the run line), `CHANGELOG.md`, the helper's usage text; board HEF-8 → `tasks/DOING.md` with "repo-scout" corrected to truth-scout; the doc-count check stays green | P2 | US1 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | `truth-scout.md` frontmatter: read-only tools, `model: sonnet`, no `memory`; body carries the digest contract, the OUT_OF_SCOPE rule and the never-list; `/hef.plan` wiring: `argument-hint`, `--arena`, the 2..3 clamp, `truth-scout`, "one message", `## Arena`, `### Unverified`, the footer format with `unverified=`, the ✓/✗/– legend, `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION`, the marker-resolution step, `[C<n>]`, `arena-cite-check`, the all-fail fallback | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-002 | `arena-metrics` on a fixture: footer + plan citing `[C2] [C5]` with C5 under Disagreements and C7 under Unverified → `cited=2 cited_from_disagreements=1 unverified=1`; no footer → non-zero with "no arena footer in"; footer lacking `agreed=` → non-zero with "footer lacks agreed="; `disagreements=2` over one listed entry → non-zero naming both; no plan.md → `cited=0`. `arena-cite-check` on a digest fixture: all-good → 0 with `ok` lines; one bad line number → non-zero with `missing <path:line>`. Mutations (the Disagreements parse dropped → `cited_from_disagreements=0`; the footer grep loosened → the "no arena footer" message disappears; the consistency check dropped → `disagreements=2` accepted; the line-count test dropped from the cite check) red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-003 | The eval passes 3/3 | `claude plugin eval` (user-run) |
| SC-004 | Dogfood: `/hef.plan --arena 3` on the NEXT feature's spec produces an Arena section, and `arena-metrics` reads it back after the plan is written | user-run, next feature |
| SC-005 | Doc counts consistent (7 agents, 44 subcommands) | smoke doc-count check |
